items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Could be Lannan's Redheads, in fact.

ctx.x: The Redheads could be anybody. Could be Lannan's Redheads, in fact.

Well, I think it was with Nichols on a few occasions. Yes. Every time. Do you remember who the jazz bands were in New York when you arrived there? There were big bands and there were small bands, weren't there, around New York? 25.
